title: Innovex International, Inc. Announces Public Offering of Common Stock by Selling Stockholders
summary: Innovex International, Inc. (NYSE: INVX) (“Innovex” or the “Company”) today announced the underwritten public offering (the “Offering”) of 5,000,000 shares of its common stock by certain affiliates of Amberjack Capital Partners, L.P. (the “Selling Stockholders”). Innovex will not sell any shares of its common stock in the Offering and will not receive any proceeds from the sale of the shares of its common stock being offered by the Selling Stockholders. The Offering is subject to market and other conditions, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when the Offering may be completed. The underwriter intends to offer the shares from time to time for sale in one or more transactions on the New York Stock Exchange, in the over-the-counter market, through negotiated transactions or otherwise at market prices prevailing at the time of sale, at prices related to prevailing market prices or at negotiated prices.
